messages:
sophia: Heads-up: AuroraEdge sent final assets for co-branded solution brief. Need logo lockups (horizontal + stacked), marketplace tile 1024x512, hero banner 1400x500, and customer quote release. Files: Figma: https://figma.com/aurora/rdwd-aurora  Drive: https://drive.google.com/aurora-assets. Target publish Thu. cc @kevin @tina

kevin: Downloaded SVGs. Partner's stacked mark has very tight descender overlap; request outline or alternate. Pushed comps to Figma with 28px clearspace suggestion.

brandbot: brandbot: Asset scan -> missing stacked clearspace variant ❌; low-res PNG found (600x300) ❌; alt text missing ❌. See /checks/1959876543

tina: Marketing: Copy draft in Drive. Using conservative phrasing: "helps reduce inference cost". Need partner ok on any numbers. I'll avoid claims until we have benchmark approval.

mohit: Legal: Need signed customer quote release and customer logo usage rights. Also remove 'always' language from the brief. I'll send redline in the morning.

jules: Design: I'll export marketplace tile @72dpi, run TinyPNG. For hero banner prefer SVG + 2x PNG. For co-branding on dark backgrounds, recommend white-outline variant of partner logo.

kevin: Uploaded outline variants: /figma/aurora/variants. Added white stroke and flat-color fallback for the gradient icon.

brandbot: brandbot: Accessibility pre-check -> hero banner contrast ok ✅; dark co-brand tile fails contrast ❌. Suggest white-background or outline. Also flagged missing alt text for marketplace tile.

sophia: Action items: sophia -> request signed releases and confirm any benchmark numbers; kevin -> finalize exports and alt text; tina -> hold numeric claims and draft AM blurb; mohit -> send redline to partner legal. I'll update here once signed.

tina: AM blurb draft: "Redwood + AuroraEdge: integrated flow for low-latency streaming inference. Link: <marketplace link>". Will expand once assets live.

mohit: Sent redline to partner legal. Asked for name + title + month/year for attribution on quote. Also asked for confirmation of customer logo usage.

brandbot: brandbot: Thread status -> pending_partner_signoff ⏳

jules: When partner returns signed release we can ship assets. Plan to schedule marketplace publish for Thursday 09:00 PT so AMs have morning link.

sophia: Thanks all. If partner cannot deliver signed release by Tue EOD we will delay publish. I'll follow up with their CSM now.

kevin: :thumbsup::skin-tone-2:
